criteria.description: Worker-backed deployments reload the selected worker from the repository after selection and before Loom SubmitJob.
If dispatch-time service_deploy admission rejects, the coordinator skips SubmitJob and marks the deployment run failed with stable admission metadata.
Workerless legacy non-unit Loom deployments are not subject to the worker-backed dispatch admission gate; Loom-routed deployment units require a resolved worker.
